official_rule_notes.original_excerpt: エンドフェイズに１度のみ発動できます。
official_rule_notes.paraphrase: Optional End Phase trigger can activate only once in that End Phase; neither activation negation nor effect negation permits another activation. Printed text has no separate once-per-turn sentence.

official_rule_notes.original_excerpt: 同一のエンドフェイズにて効果が再び発動する事はありません。
official_rule_notes.paraphrase: Mandatory End Phase trigger likewise does not activate again within the same End Phase after activation or effect negation. Printed text has no separate once-per-turn sentence.

existing_native_evidence.scope: Current full Sundew/installed metadata/corrected transport/no Lua API adapter. Native Pendulum history and two real field-to-faceup-Extra origins; spare legal resource remains after success. Exactly one End Phase offer after success, activation negation or effect negation. Effective limit/response/operation controls. Neutral setup and Counter Trap. Supports retaining phase limit; not full-card/live Omega certification.

conclusion: Retain per-source once-per-phase End Phase trigger limit. Official optional and mandatory phase-trigger notes independently support the existing native success/activation-negation/effect-negation controls. Applied to custom Sundew by analogy; no direct custom-card ruling or live Omega proof. Retained destroyed-Pendulum count alone does not grant a second activation.

reference.provenance: Unofficial English translation of OCG Perfect Rulebook 2017; Japanese original not inspected
reference.interpretation: End Phase trigger cannot activate again after activation negation; supports current once-per-phase implementation, not an additional printed named OPT.

previous_reference.disposition: Historical unofficial translation kept; Japanese Perfect Rulebook original still not inspected. Primary Konami notes now provide independent ruling provenance, so an untranslated book is no longer the sole support.
